description: The shared Research Persona view with authored read-only surface props. Synthetic examples prove presentation only, not persisted customer records, native execution or research findings. The same underlying view remains editable through authorized product and MCP adapters.
name: Persona

propsSchema.description: JSON options for createPersonaFromProps(root, {value, locale}), which calls the existing createPersonaView. Value is an authored Persona surface DTO with read-only capabilities, not a native profile or MCP envelope. The bounded public schema checks hash length; native surface validation also checks lowercase hexadecimal syntax. Props supply no actions, transport or image bytes.

requiredStates.reason: The Details summary is keyboard focusable. This declaration does not yet provide a focused-state scenario or raster.
Loading belongs to the MCP adapter lifecycle. The public JSON entry requires a supplied value and has no loading prop; no loading scenario is provided.
The native capability values disable avatar generation and grant no field editing. The Details control remains usable.
A Persona surface requires an identity and cannot be null. Missing portraits or optional field values are valid ready-card content, not an empty Persona.
The shared view and adapters expose operation/transport errors. This read-only JSON entry has no error prop and no error scenario is provided.
The authored canonical surface renders all seven fields and the native missing-image placeholder.
